findings.title: Instance transform is applied twice
findings.body: GeometryInstance.GetInstanceGeometry() returns instance geometry with the instance transform already applied. The code then multiplies geomInst.Transform into currentTransform and applies that transform again to every point. Translated or rotated CAD links will therefore produce incorrect foundation centers and orientations. Use GetInstanceGeometry() without adding geomInst.Transform, or use GetSymbolGeometry() and explicitly accumulate transforms.

findings.title: Selection cancellation is reported as command failure
findings.body: PickObject throws Autodesk.Revit.Exceptions.OperationCanceledException when the user presses Escape. The generic exception handler converts this normal cancellation into Result.Failed. Catch OperationCanceledException separately and return Result.Cancelled.
